context: Evaluates whether the agent logs a PORT_CANDIDATE result correctly without letting the log entry substitute for the finding or plan a real decision needs.

checklist.name: Correct verdict value
checklist.description: verdict is set to PORT_CANDIDATE, the strongest signal in the enum

checklist.name: Separate finding or plan filed
checklist.description: Does not let the log entry substitute for the finding or plan this real decision needs -- files one via context-file or plan-create

checklist.name: related field populated
checklist.description: The log entry's related field points at the newly created finding or plan once it exists

checklist.name: Finding has real substance
checklist.description: The finding or plan itself documents the technique and recommendation in enough detail to act on, not just a one-line pointer

checklist.name: Validation run
checklist.description: validate-repo-scouting-log.sh run or its command shown before declaring the entry logged
